all.source_quote: Must be pursuing studies in a recognized institution
Class XI onward, including higher secondary, undergraduate, postgraduate, or professional courses

unmodelled.text: Must be an Indian citizen from SC, ST, OBC or a notified minority group
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be an Indian citizen and belong to eligible categories such as SC, ST, OBC, or notified minority groups.

unmodelled.text: Must have passed Class 10 or an equivalent exam from a recognised board
unmodelled.source_quote: Should have passed Class 10 (matriculation) or equivalent examination from a recognized board.

unmodelled.text: Family income within the prescribed limit (commonly Rs 2.5 lakh; varies by category and scheme)
unmodelled.source_quote: Annual family income should be within the prescribed limit (commonly up to Rs 2.5 lakh, though it may vary by category and scheme).

unmodelled.text: Must not get another scholarship for the same purpose
unmodelled.source_quote: Should not be receiving another scholarship for the same purpose.
